item.title: [LLY0.F] Lilly's Foundayo weight loss pill clears heart safety bar in largest diabetes trial yet
item.description: Eli Lilly reported Phase 3 results showing cardiovascular safety for its oral GLP-1 Foundayo as the company prepares a Type 2 diabetes submission. The ACHIEVE-4 trial enrolled 2,749 participants across 15 countries, comparing Foundayo with insulin glargine and meeting non-inferiority for major cardiovascular events with a hazard ratio of 0.84. After 52 weeks, A1C dropped 1.6 percentage points on Foundayo versus 1.0 with insulin, and weight fell by 17.9 pounds (8.8%) while insulin users gained about 3.1 pounds. Safety aligned with GLP-1 class effects; 10.6% discontinued due to gastrointestinal side effects, and no liver safety signal emerged. A secondary analysis noted a 57% reduction in all-cause mortality, not adjusted for multiple comparisons, and Lilly plans an FDA filing by the end of Q2.

item.title: [TSM] The Week in Numbers: major Netflix exit, luxury fashion struggles
item.description:
STORY: From a major Netflix exit to luxury being out of fashion for cost-conscious spenders... this is The Week in Numbers.

:: 9%

As much as 9% is how far Netflix shares plunged on the news of a big departure.

Company chairman and co-founder Reed Hastings announced he's leaving after 29 years with the entertainment giant.

It comes with Netflix looking for new avenues of growth as sales slow due to competition...

The firm also forecast earnings per share in the current quarter below analyst expectations.

:: 58%

58% is how high first-quarter profit leapt for TSMC to hit a record $18.2 billion.

The world's biggest contract manufacturer of advanced AI chips saw massive demand for its products.

The company further raised its annual revenue forecast.

And said it's stepping up capital spending this year to potentially as high as $56 billion.

:: $11.5 billion

$11.5 billion is how much Amazon said it would pay to buy satellite firm Globalstar.

Shares in both firms soared after the update.

It's another sign the online giant wants to compete with Elon Musk's rival Starlink.

The deal sees Amazon add Globalstar's two dozen satellites to its existing network of more than 200.

:: 14%

As much as 14% is how far Hermes shares sank after a weak sales update.

It was a tough week for luxury fashion brands as stock prices dropped at other top names like Gucci owner Kering.

Investors sold off as the war in Iran weighed on demand in the Middle East and tourism in Europe.

The conflict has been felt from Dubai mall sales to soaring energy prices hitting consumer spending.

:: 20%

And 20% is how high analysts raised earnings forecasts for BP.

The energy major said it expects its huge oil trading desk to post 'exceptional' results for the first quarter.

It signals a windfall from the spike in oil prices caused by the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.

Rival Shell also gave a similar outlook for Q1 due to strong oil trading results.
